about_the_game:
[Overview]
Nemesis is an additional character in the fan-made fighting game "MGCM Combat Edition," where you can battle with the charming characters, magical girls, and demons from the new-generation urban pop magical girl RPG "I Am Magicami."
The original Iroha Asobe, she crawled from the void of abandoned world, shared the power of Luxuria, and became a transcendent being, the embodiment of obsession.
As the protagonist, she will dominate your opponents from start to finish with her overwhelming fighting abilities!

content_descriptors.notes: This includes costume changes to thinner costumes, and certain techniques that suggest sexual acts. It also includes depictions of blood splatter during battles.
